Main_Activities: Define the business problem, intended purpose, system objectives, and potential risks.
Governance_Controls: Document intended use, identify stakeholders, and perform an initial risk assessment.

Main_Activities: Collect, inspect, clean, and prepare the dataset.
Governance_Controls: Check data quality, document data sources, and consider privacy and fairness requirements.

Main_Activities: Train and optimize the customer churn prediction model.
Governance_Controls: Document model configurations, experiments, and development decisions.

Main_Activities: Evaluate predictive performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
Governance_Controls: Review model performance, limitations, and potential bias before approval.

Main_Activities: Integrate the selected model into an operational environment.
Governance_Controls: Require deployment approval, access controls, and appropriate testing.

Main_Activities: Monitor data distributions and model performance over time.
Governance_Controls: Detect data drift, review performance changes, and generate monitoring reports.

Main_Activities: Review model behavior, investigate issues, and evaluate the need for retraining.
Governance_Controls: Document model changes, validate updated models, and maintain version records.

Main_Activities: Withdraw outdated or unsuitable models from operational use.
Governance_Controls: Approve model retirement, archive relevant records, and manage associated data responsibly.
